decisions.reason: The client confirms retaining the 7 cm and 17 cm block-pareo border measurements, and the candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording those measurements.

The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY capturing the selected smaller Zebra Noir direction, removal of the border, edge-to-edge repeat treatment, and removal of the obsolete scale-comparison option.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording that the basket-weave repeat has no border and extends to the edge; no additional stale attribute is necessarily removed.
Retaining the block-pareo border measurements does not change the candidate's general production-file, printing, fabric, or colour-preparation specifications.
The candidate already has a same-message Event recording the confirmed 1.5 cm seam allowance and its rolled-hem purpose.

The candidate already represents the same-message acceptance of the proposed CMYK and Pantone reference documentation; the block-pareo border-width decision requires no further documentation-state change.
